card.name: CYP enzyme inducers lowering drug levels
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction text about CYP3A or CYP2C inducers, including the pieces of the word inducers and the words leading up to a statement that levels will be lowered. Also fires on a few nearby spots such as 'total' before cortisol and a comma in a drug list.
